date_created.label: Date created
date_created.help_text: The moment when the item was created.

date_modified.label: Date modified
date_modified.help_text: The last moment when the item was modified. A value in year 1750 indicates the value is unknown

source.label: Source
source.help_text: the source of the audio file, one of: C (court website), H (brad heath archive)

case_name_short.label: Case name short
case_name_short.help_text: The abridged name of the case, often a single word, e.g. 'Marsh'

case_name.label: Case name
case_name.help_text: The full name of the case

case_name_full.label: Case name full
case_name_full.help_text: The full name of the case

judges.label: Judges
judges.help_text: The judges that heard the oral arguments as a simple text string. This field is used when normalized judges cannot be placed into the panel field.

sha1.label: Sha1
sha1.help_text: unique ID for the document, as generated via SHA1 of the binary file or text data

download_url.label: Download url
download_url.help_text: The URL on the court website where the document was originally scraped

local_path_mp3.label: Local path mp3
local_path_mp3.help_text: The location in AWS S3 where our enhanced copy of the original audio file is stored. Note that the field name is historical, from before when we used S3. To find the location in S3, concatenate https://storage.courtlistener.com/ and the value of this field.

local_path_original_file.label: Local path original file
local_path_original_file.help_text: The location in AWS S3 where the original audio file downloaded from the court is stored. Note that the field name is historical, from before when we used S3. To find the location in S3, concatenate https://storage.courtlistener.com/ and the value of this field.

filepath_ia.label: Filepath ia
filepath_ia.help_text: The URL of the file in IA

ia_upload_failure_count.label: Ia upload failure count
ia_upload_failure_count.help_text: Number of times the upload to the Internet Archive failed.

duration.label: Duration
duration.help_text: the length of the item, in seconds

processing_complete.label: Processing complete
processing_complete.help_text: Is audio for this item done processing?

date_blocked.label: Date blocked
date_blocked.help_text: The date that this opinion was blocked from indexing by search engines

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.help_text: Should this item be blocked from indexing by search engines?

stt_status.label: Speech to text status
stt_status.help_text: The status of the Speech to Text for this item?

choices.display_name: File size is bigger than 25 MB

stt_source.label: Speech to text source
stt_source.help_text: Source used to get the transcription
